page.content:
Dojo line of Jun and Asuka — the other blood in Jin's name.

How Kazama family connects

  • Character: Jun Kazama — Jun Kazama is the spiritual center of the Kazama family.
  • Character: Asuka Kazama — Asuka Kazama carries the Osaka Kazama dojo line.

What is Kazama family?

The Kazama family is the martial-arts household opposite the Mishimas: Jun's spiritually grounded style, Asuka's Osaka dojo, and the name Jin carries beside Devil Gene.

Key threads lead to Jun Kazama and Asuka Kazama.
